skeleton.note: rest = armature-space matrix_local in the blend (rig object transform identity, scale 1, metres; values x100). Old = SourceArt/Warden/V5_5w2 blend. The UE SK_Warden_Skeleton itself was not read (Unreal stays closed); V11.1's own verification (import-v11_1.json) imported the mesh onto the V5 skeleton without error.
skeleton.mask_socket_in_project: SK_Warden mesh socket 'mask' on bone head, zero offset (Docs/ArtTest/warden/p13_reimport_pre.json). The native V11.1 SK_Warden.uasset has no socket (no SkeletalMeshSocket and no 'mask' name in the package).

orientation.finding: The unrotated V11.1 exports use the same export.py logic, the same -Y forward / Z up axes and the same facing (-Y in the blend) as V5_5w2's. The P13 rule applies unchanged: they need the +90 deg Z turn (x,y)->(-y,x) (p13_export_lods_rotated.py) before the Force-Front-X import.
orientation.dry_run: p13_export_lods_rotated.py was run on the V11.1 blend with --out in a scratch folder (not committed): 3 files (3,840,172 / 2,227,676 / 1,080,364 bytes), 8 slots in order, bounds centre (-7.11, 15.45) = the unrotated centre (15.45, 7.11) turned by (x,y)->(-y,x), as for V5_5w2. The blend was not saved.

export_warning: reports/export.log: 'Mesh geometry_0.002/.006/.010 has polygons with more than 4 vertices, cannot compute/export tangent space': the FBX of each LOD carries no tangents (V5_5w2 had no such n-gons). LOD0 has 18 n-gons (slots 0, 1, 5, 7).

clips.current_source: SourceArt/Warden/V5_5/exports/AN_Warden_*.fbx (the P13 reweight never changed the clips; V5_5w2 has no clip FBX; the project's AN_Warden_Idle/Walk/DoorwayStoop come from V5.5, commit e8d57a2)
clips.method: each FBX imported into an empty Blender scene with identical default settings; armature-space bone head positions (evaluated pose) at 5 frames per clip, 110 bones. The owner's own check (Verification/check-v11_1.json) shows clip-to-blend error <= 0.0007 cm.
clips.verdict: NOT identical. Same bone names and count, same frame counts and lengths (4.0 s / 2.0 s / 3.0 s at 30 fps). Legs, pelvis, spine, neck, head, clavicles and upper arms are unchanged (< 0.1 cm); the lower arms, hands, fingers and the chain_l/chain_r bones differ by a near-constant offset of up to 19.5 cm at the finger tips (5.4-5.7 cm at the elbows); the stoop also differs in the left chain by up to 30 cm. Cause: the arm and hand pose of the revision.

mask.faces: material slot 1 M_Warden_BellMetal: 9156 polys / 9252 tris / 4688 verts / 1539 cm2 in LOD0 (V5_5w2: 8513 tris, 1234 cm2). 9 islands: the mask shell (4536 verts), 6 mouth studs (20 verts each) and 2 small ones near the left eye. All of slot 1 is mask (all inside the mask bounds).
mask.largest_other_weight: none: every mask vertex has exactly one influence, head 1.0 (100 %), in LOD0, LOD1 and LOD2
mask.head_bone_axes_reading: bone Y = world up (+Z), bone Z = the Warden's forward (world -Y in the blend), bone X = world +X (the Warden's left)

bounds_in_SK_mesh_space_unreal_cm_derive.rule: Blender (x,y,z) -> P13 rotated export -> UE (-y,-x,z) (the figure faces Blender -Y = mesh +X); derived, not read from the engine

mask.render_setup: Cycles GPU, 48 samples + denoise; the owner's closeups.py 'mask' camera (ortho 0.70, at (0.35,-2,2.6) looking at (0,-0.5,2.5)); Idle frame 1; the owner's three area lights and 0.12 grey world; LOD0 only (the blend carries LOD0.001..005 leftovers, hidden from render); mask faces deleted in memory. The blend was not saved. Script: Tools/blender/warden/w0_render_mask.py
mask.under_the_mask: A void. There is no face, skin or head geometry: slot 3 Skin is forearms and hands only (z 80-194 cm). Behind the mask there is only the two-sided wool hood interior, on average 17 cm behind the mask's back plane (23.7 cm behind its centroid plane), which renders black. What stays on the head (all 100 % head) when the mask faces go: two thin DimEyes strips (slot 6, 40 tris, x -5.2..5.2, z 252.2-252.7, y -45.8, about 6.8 cm behind the mask front: the orange pin-points in the render); two small Keratin rings at the eye slits (slot 7); six tiny Keratin dots at the mouth (slot 7, z 240-243.5, the same places as the six metal studs); two small Leather bits at the cheeks (slot 4, z 252-256, x +-8.2).
mask.f0b_rule_result: The mask-off render shows the dark hood interior only (plus the two dim eyes and a few specks), so plan section 4.2 adds no HoodVoid.

materials.source: Verification/materials-v11_1.json, cloth-update-v11_1.json, saved-v11_1.json, and the names and enum values readable in the native .uasset files (strings only; the numeric defaults are binary and were not decoded)

slots.params: none: three texture samples (BaseColor, NormalDX, ORM at 2048) and constants; no scalar or vector parameter

slots.blend: BLEND_Opaque; emissive driven by camera distance (CameraPositionWS, WorldPosition, Distance, Clamp), so the glow fades with distance from the camera

materials.current_project_M_Warden_BellMetal: BLEND_Opaque, DefaultLit, with scalar TellGlow and vector TellGlowColor (Tools/warden/apply_p12f_art.py, D-092) and no Fade. The plan's fallback therefore applies either way: switch the mask slot to M_LB_Invisible, or build a Fade variant.

textures.sizes: 6 at 4096 (wool and skin sets), 2 at 1024 (wool detail), 12 at 2048 (BellMetal, ChainIron, Leather, RustedIron sets)
textures.note: V11.1's BellMetal, RustedIron, Leather and ChainIron textures are detailed maps (BellMetal BaseColor 2.7 MB); the project's current BellMetal and RustedIron texture packages are only 26-66 KB (near-flat maps).
